gap_fill_decisions: compression = short-term range (ATR8, 2h) at most 70% of the 12h norm (ATR48); breakout = close beyond the prior 2h extreme
outcome horizon 2 h (member of the registry set)
missing_in_source: position-sizing rule (supplied by the EUR 500 capital model of this task)
single outcome horizon (registry lists candidate sets only)
cost model (supplied by the shared harness)
name: FAST -- Volatility Breakout / Expansion

exits: time exit at the first 15m boundary >= entry fill + 120 min
operationalization.rule: At the prior bar t-1, compressed if ATR8/ATR48 <= 0.7. At bar t: LONG if C_t > max(H over bars t-8..t-1); SHORT if C_t < min(L over bars t-8..t-1).

source_registry.original_signal_definition: CONCEPT ONLY: a period of compressed range/volatility is followed by directional expansion. No formula frozen.
source_registry.required_data: 1-minute canonical FX bars for range/ATR construction, derived coarser frequencies.
